editorial_output.canonical_editorial_headline: Turkey asks for Interpol notices for Netanyahu over flotilla case — [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)
editorial_output.dek: Justice Minister Akin Gurlek says the request follows July 14 Turkish arrest warrants; the supplied evidence does not establish that Interpol has acted. [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)
editorial_output.article_body:
Turkey's justice ministry asked the interior ministry to issue Interpol red notices for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and one other, unnamed suspect, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said. The Turkish arrest warrants were issued on July 14. [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)

According to the supplied report, the warrants allege genocide, crimes against humanity and torture in a case arising from Israel's May interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla. Those allegations are the stated basis of the Turkish case; the supplied evidence does not independently establish them as findings. [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)

France, Italy and Australia have also launched judicial proceedings related to the flotilla interception, the report says. [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)

The central procedural question remains unresolved. The supplied record does not say whether Interpol has reviewed, accepted or rejected Turkey's request, and it does not identify the second suspect. The record confirms the Turkish request; it does not confirm that Interpol has issued a red notice. [Source: Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/21/turkiye-accuses-israels-netanyahu-of-genocide-seeks-interpol-warrant)
